name: agentisend
description: AgentiSend is a transactional email API for AI agents. Check what you may spend, preflight a send for free, and ask a person when a send is risky. Use when sending transactional or product email, when a send was refused and you need the fix, or when setting up a sending domain.

commands.name: emails send
commands.summary: Send one email. Use - with --text-file/--html-file to read the body from stdin.

commands.name: emails cancel
commands.summary: Cancel a scheduled or queued message.

commands.name: emails explain
commands.summary: Why a message ended the way it did, with the fix as callable steps.

commands.name: domains list
commands.summary: List sending domains and their status.

commands.name: webhooks listen
commands.summary: Verify deliveries locally and forward them to your app with the same headers and bytes.

commands.name: receiving listen
commands.summary: Stream inbound messages as NDJSON, one JSON object per line.

commands.name: limits resume
commands.summary: Undo a kill switch. A person signed in to the console does this; a key is refused.

commands.name: trust standing
commands.summary: This account's standing and the reasons behind it.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Check credentials, reachability, kill switch, budget, domains and standing.

commands.name: profile list
commands.summary: Show configured profiles and which is current.

commands.name: profile set
commands.summary: Create or update a profile. The key is stored 0600 and never printed back.

commands.name: completions
commands.summary: Print a completion script for bash, zsh or fish.
